text:
kevin: heads-up: onboarding test failed for acme integration. toolcall streaming in json-mode + auth-retry ended up with schema validator complaining about array vs object shape after retry. super confusing for customer.
maya: can you paste the exact observed vs expected? short snippet ok.
kevin: expected: {"items": [{"id":1}]}
observed after retry: "{\"items\": [{\"id\":1}]}" (quoted JSON) so downstream validator ran a JSON.parse and produced a string -> our schema lib then coerces singletons to arrays incorrectly.
toni: interesting twist: our schema validator has a coercion rule that says string -> split into array if schema expects array of strings; it saw a string and interpreted it as a single-token array; that masked the real issue.
sam: ack. this is two bugs colliding: 1) retry double-encode on buffered streaming chunks, 2) overly eager coercion rule in our validator. together they produced a subtle shape change.
kevin: repro steps I recorded: 1) start streaming toolcall with preserveStrings=true 2) buffer holds rawText chunks 3) token refresh triggers retry; retry wrapper stringifies buffer without checking format 4) consumer validateToolOutput(schema, { mode: 'coerce' }) runs and coerces the string into an array unexpectedly.
maya: proposal: short-term revert coercion for strings when schema expects complex objects. Long-term: make validator require explicit coerce options and add a pre-validate normalizer that ensures payload is object if format metadata says json.
toni: SDK parity note: node currently exposes buffer.format tag but python does not. that means py retry path double-encodes more often. we should align runtimes: StreamChunk { format: 'json'|'text', rawText?: string, asObject?: object } and retry should prefer asObject when format==='json'.
sam: test plan: add unit tests for validator to ensure string->array coercion only applied for primitive arrays, not object-array schemas; add integration auth-mock test that simulates mid-stream refresh and asserts no double-encoding in both node+py. add matrix job to CI.
kevin: quick mitigation pushed in sample-kit PR that does safe-parse-if-json before retry, and changed validator coercion toggle behind an opt-in flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-kit/pull/1512 (label: hotfix)
sdk-ci: created issue #3017: "devex: streamer/retry parity + validator coercion false positives causing onboarding shape bugs" assigned to @maya and @toni
maya: i'll draft the StreamChunk interface spec and validator normalizer RFC. trying to prioritize before next sample-kit release so we don't regress more customers.
toni: i'll add python parity patch and the coercion unit tests. thanks for the clear repro, kevin :thumbsup:
